scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run test
scripts.lock:check: npm run lock:regen && git diff --exit-code package-lock.json
scripts.version: changeset version && uv version --no-sync $(node -p "require('./packages/srg-types/package.json').version") && uv lock --project examples/integrations/jev && npm install --package-lock-only --strict-peer-deps --prefer-dedupe
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run test && changeset publish
